correctness.rationale: For a single iid continuous labelling, evaluate mixed local-extremum indicators by conditioning on adjacent vertex labels (positive covariance), their unique common neighbor at distance two (negative covariance), and use neighborhood independence for distance >=3. This gives the exact degree-wedge identity. Substituting the leaf/root/internal degree classes and pair counts on T_{m,h} yields for h>=3 Cov=n L_m+R_m, with explicit polynomials in m and factorial correction. After t=m-2>=0, displayed coefficients for -L_m, -R_m, and the h=2 expression are all strictly positive; h=1 follows monotonicity under the uniform root rank. The variance formula has positive asymptotic V_m. Paths give Cov=(8n-37)/180 and Corr->+1, while the complete regular branching class is strictly negative with rho_2=-19/33, rho_m->-1. Independent exact permutation examples and rational identities corroborate formulas, not their unbounded family proof.
